title: Ruya, North Oil Company: expediting and topside weight control
anonTitle: Enhanced expediting and topside weight control, Qatar
scope: Enhanced expediting, shop visits and topside weight control.
challenge: The EPC contractor needed equipment packages followed up at vendor shops, and a topside weight report it could rely on while vendor data kept changing.
approach: Enhanced expediting with shop visits to vendor works.
Expediting reports to the contractor's format.
Topside weight control: vendor weights fed into the weight report as they were received.
Weight changes traced to their source.
reviewNotes: Asset type set to 'Process platforms' as an assumption: confirm the platform type.
Narrative drafted from the one-line scope: confirm with the project lead.
